items.item_text: 01. The information provided in your application must support your selected answers in the supplemental questions. The information you provide will be verified and documentation may be required. Please be as honest and accurate as possible. You may be asked to demonstrate your knowledge and skills in a work sample or during an interview. By completing this supplemental questionnaire you are attesting that the information you have provided is accurate. Any misstatements, omissions, or falsification of information may eliminate you from consideration or result in dismissal. Options: Yes, I understand and agree | No, I do not agree
02. I understand that the Santa Paula Unified School District Classified HR Office will communicate with me via email and that it is my responsibility to check my email. Options: Yes | No
03. Are you a current regular classified employee (substitute employment not included)? Options: Yes | No
04. Do you have a High School diploma or GED? Options: Yes | No
05. The position requires one year of experience in security or experience working with adolescent students. Do you meet this requirement? Options: Yes | No

06. Campus Security Officer - Please describe where and how you gained experience in security or experience working with adolescent students, including names of employers, dates of employment, and duties performed. If you do not have this experience, please indicate "N/A".

07. Temporary Assignment Interest: Are you interested in being considered for temporary Campus Security Officer assignments? Options: Yes, I am interested in temporary assignments. | No, I am only interested in regular positions.
Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school and one year of experience in security or experience working with adolescent students.

Patrol and supervise assigned areas of campus, assuring students are safe, orderly, and within supervised areas; assure non-students on campus are authorized visitors; monitor lunch areas, walkways, restrooms, parking lots and adjacent areas.

Enforce school and District rules, regulations and procedures; investigate and report unusual, suspicious or criminal activities; prevent or break up student conflicts and fights; investigate students under the influence of alcohol/drugs.

Investigate and report instances of gang activities, theft, graffiti and vandalism; take photographs; prepare student referrals and contracts as appropriate; prepare summaries or reports on related issues and place students on Extended Contract; advise student and parent in writing of behavior against the District or school rules and policies; receive and file signed contracts; make notes in student disciplinary records as appropriate; assist with the removal of graffiti.

Monitor student behavior and activity during passing periods and lunchtime; assure students arrive to class in a timely manner; assure students have proper permission slips outside of classrooms during instruction periods; assure students have proper authorization before leaving campus.
Escort and direct authorized visitors to desired destinations; escort delinquent students to and from administration offices; retrieve students as requested by administrators.
Administer emergency first aid and CPR as necessary; arrange for emergency medical services as needed; serve as first responder to emergency situations.

Monitor campus for illegal activity; search backpacks, cars, clothing and lockers for and confiscate tobacco, drugs, weapons, paraphernalia and other illegal or unauthorized possessions according to established procedures and regulations as assigned.

Communicate with personnel to exchange information and resolve issues or concerns; provide information to and assist police in matters of illegal student activity and behavior; prepare incident reports.
Assist teachers with removing unruly or disruptive students from the classroom as needed.
Provide security during sporting events, dances and other special events and after-school activities.
Participate in the resolution of other issues including gang activity, missing students, stolen property and cyber-bullying as needed.
Unlock and lock gates, hallway doors or lockers as assigned.
Provide translations between parents, students, staff or others in a designated second language as assigned by the position.
Operate a two-way radio and walkie-talkie; respond to radio calls
OTHER DUTIES:
Perform related duties as assigned.
Methods of individual and group supervision.
Gang and graffiti recognition and involvement.
Basic interests, attitudes and emotional development of adolescents.
Health and safety regulations.
Basic report preparation techniques.
Oral and written communication skills.
Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy.
